title: Millionaire for Life Number Watch — An All-Odd Line Just Landed
headline: An All-Odd Line Just Landed

prose.intro: The Millionaire for Life machine skipped half the pool this draw. All 5 numbers came in odd.
prose.fact: Across recent Millionaire for Life draws the split clusters around the halfway mark. A line with all 5 numbers odd is the far edge of the range.
prose.context: The usual reminder applies, and it matters most on days like this: draws are independent. A streak, a gap or an odd shape says nothing about what the next drawing will do. We log these because they describe the data, not because they change it.
